summary: Retest of 3 AI features under CRM Settings -> Price List. (1) AI bundle suggestions: WORKS end-to-end - 5 suggestions render, POST /api/crm/products returns 200 and the 'Created' green badge appears on the suggestion row (verified visually in screenshot bundle_after_create.png on first run). (2) Drawer AI improve grammar: FULLY WORKING - typed text with typos, clicked product-drawer-ai-clean -> suggestion appeared in ~3s with corrected grammar, 'Use this' replaced the textarea, Save persisted (PATCH /api/crm/products/<id> -> 200). (3) Import wizard AI explain issues: BLOCKED by a 500 on upload - the small workbook /app/test_samples/pulse_price_list_small_with_errors.xlsx is POSTed to /api/crm/products/bulk-import (CSV endpoint) instead of the price-list xlsx import endpoint; backend raises _csv.Error: new-line character seen in unquoted field, so the wizard never advances past step 1 and plw-to-preview / plw-ai-summary-block never render.

critical.issue: Import wizard (CRMPriceListImportWizard.js) is uploading the XLSX file to the CSV bulk-import endpoint. Backend tries csv.DictReader on binary xlsx bytes and raises _csv.Error -> 500. This blocks the entire Preview step and the new plw-ai-summary-block AI feature.

ui_bugs.issue: After successful POST /api/crm/products (HTTP 200), the modal re-fetches AI suggestions and replaces the entire list. The bundle-created-<idx> badge IS rendered for the just-created suggestion (Spin Studio Starter Pack showed 'Created' green pill in screenshot), but the index moves so an automated test pinned to bundle-created-0 may time-out. Consider keeping the index stable post-create (or do not auto-refetch) and ensure data-testid='bundle-created-<idx>' remains attached to the same row that was clicked.
Bottom-right Install App prompt and bottom-center cookie banner overlay action controls in the modal; can intercept clicks on lower create-bundle rows.

integration_issues.flow: Import wizard preview -> AI explain issues
integration_issues.issue: Wizard upload posts to /api/crm/products/bulk-import (CSV endpoint) -> 500 from _csv.Error. Should target the xlsx import-wizard endpoint (e.g. /api/crm/price-list/import/upload). Result: cannot reach Preview step -> plw-ai-summary-block / plw-ai-summary-btn / plw-ai-summary-result never appear.

action_items: Fix CRMPriceListImportWizard.js to POST the .xlsx upload to the correct price-list import endpoint (not /api/crm/products/bulk-import). After fix, the Preview step should render and plw-ai-summary-block should appear with the Summarise button.

(Minor) In CRMBundleSuggestModal.js, do NOT re-fetch /price-list/ai-bundle-suggestions immediately after a successful create — it reorders the rows and makes the 'Created' badge appear on a different index than the one the user clicked. Either freeze the list once shown or key the Created/Error state by suggestion id rather than index.
(Minor) Auto-suppress the 'Install App' PWA prompt and cookie banner while wizard / drawer modals are open so they cannot intercept clicks.
critical_code_review_comments: Import wizard wiring bug: front-end uploads XLSX to the CSV /api/crm/products/bulk-import handler; backend csv.DictReader chokes (_csv.Error: new-line character seen in unquoted field). Either route to the dedicated price-list xlsx endpoint or branch in the backend by Content-Type.

CRMBundleSuggestModal refetches the suggestions list right after a successful create — combined with index-based data-testid this confuses automation and users (the row they just created visually jumps).
Backend tracebacks show no input-validation guard before csv.DictReader; should pre-check file extension/content-type and return a 400 with a clear message rather than 500.

success_rate.frontend: ~67% — 2 of 3 AI features fully working (bundles + drawer grammar). Wizard AI summary blocked by upload-routing bug.

rca of the issue: Repro: open import wizard, set file /app/test_samples/pulse_price_list_small_with_errors.xlsx. Network: POST https://.../api/crm/products/bulk-import -> 500. Backend log: csv.DictReader -> _csv.Error: new-line character seen in unquoted field. Root cause: the wizard front-end is calling the CSV bulk-import endpoint (/api/crm/products/bulk-import in routes/crm_products.py) with a binary .xlsx file. It should call the price-list xlsx upload endpoint (the same one whose pytest /app/backend/tests/test_iter_220p1_price_ai.py passes 7/7). Mitigation: change the wizard upload URL OR add an xlsx branch in the backend bulk-import handler. Once fixed, re-run UI test to confirm plw-to-preview, plw-ai-summary-block, plw-ai-summary-btn and plw-ai-summary-result.
